core_concepts.description: A logical page/slot inside a deck.
A rendering variant of a slide or slide set.
An editable visual object inside a slide.
Reusable business value stored once and rendered in one or more blocks.
Mapping from persistent field to slide/block usage.
Backend job that updates affected slides/blocks/exports.
Judgment of a slide/variant on scroll/play/print/thumbnail/editor surfaces.

product_rule: The editor, map, smart-edit, rebuild, review matrix, and exports must consume the same deck model.
anti_patterns: Editor uses local-only mock slides while Smart Edit uses persistent fields.
Frontend stores backend secrets or model training logic.
AI directly mutates the deck without proposal, guardrail review, audit, and versioning.
